note: Triennial election of Down County Council. Nominations were received at the County Courthouse, Downpatrick, on 26 April 1933; polls took place on Thursday 25 May 1933 in the two divisions still contested, Castlewellan and Portaferry, and the other eighteen were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 24 April, 27 April, 4 May and 27 May 1933). No party labels are printed, so none are given. Majority 316. Announced 26 May 1933.
